content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 Sinclair Broadcast Group: Sr. Principal Data Engineer / Data Architect Texas 🇺🇸 United States of America Analytics, Cross-Browser Development, Decision Frameworks, Cross-Selling, Email Campaigns, Analytics Tools, Email Campaigns, Campaign Management, Ecommerce Web Development, and Ecommerce Management Design Full-Time <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Austin, TX, United States <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://sbgi.net">http://sbgi.net</a> </p> <div><strong>Description</strong><br><p><b>Location:</b> United States (Remote)</p> <p><b>Reports to:</b> SVP of Tech</p> <div> &nbsp; </div> <div> As the Sr. Principal Data Engineer, you will be the primary architect of Digital Remedy’s next-generation data platform. You won't just move data; you will design the blueprints for how we handle massive-scale AdTech telemetry. You will bridge the gap between business priorities and technical execution, ensuring our "Partner" integrations are scalable, cost-efficient, and resilient. </div> <div> &nbsp; </div> <p><b>Key Responsibilities</b></p> <ul> <li><b>Architectural Leadership:</b> Design and oversee the migration/optimization of our data lakehouse architecture using Databricks.</li> <li><b>Production Excellence:</b> Serve as the escalation point for the platform, leveraging a&nbsp;<b>proven record of handling production issues</b> to ensure 24/7 reliability of mission-critical pipelines.</li> <li><b>Strategic Capacity Planning:</b> Work directly with the SVP of Tech to translate product roadmaps into technical requirements. This requires the&nbsp;<b>ability to multi-task</b> across various high-priority workstreams without losing sight of architectural integrity.</li> <li><b>Infrastructure as Code:</b> Drive the adoption of Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) to standardize deployments across dev, staging, and production.</li> <li><b>Mentorship &amp; Governance:</b> Provide high-level guidance to engineering squads in India and the US, defining schemas and governance models for BigQuery and Databricks.</li> <li>Work with engineers across multiple geographies and time zones.</li> </ul> <p><b>Mandatory Requirements</b></p> <ul> <li><b>Expert-Level Databricks:</b> Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience specifically within the Databricks ecosystem (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Photon).</li> <li><b>The Stack:</b> Deep proficiency in Spark (PySpark/Scala), Python, and SQL. Experience with GCP (BigQuery) is a major plus.</li> <li><b>Scale:</b> Proven experience managing petabyte-scale datasets and high-concurrency pipelines (AdTech experience preferred).</li> <li><b>Independent Execution:</b> Must be a self-starter capable of taking a high-level concept from the SVP and driving it to completion with minimal supervision.</li> <li><b>Experience:</b> 10+ years in Data Engineering, with at least 3 years in a Principal or Architect capacity.</li> </ul> <p><b>Preferred Qualifications</b></p> <ul> <li><b>Incident Management:</b> A history of successfully diagnosing and resolving complex, large-scale production bottlenecks and data outages.</li> <li><b>Context Switching:</b> A demonstrated&nbsp;<b>ability to multi-task</b>, balancing long-term architectural R&amp;D with immediate business requests and partner integrations.</li> <li><b>FinOps &amp; Communication:</b> Strong understanding of optimizing Databricks/BigQuery costs and the ability to communicate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><i>Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, or related programs.</i></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><b>Why Digital Remedy?</b></p> <p>We are in a high-growth phase, integrating innovative tech from recent acquisitions. You will have a seat at the table to influence our long-term technical strategy and help us "build and scale" for the future.</p> <div> <br> Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. </div> <div> <br><b>About Sinclair</b> </div> <p>Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 178 television stations in 81 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair’s AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts.
